solutions.title: Binary search each complement
solutions.strategy: For each left index, binary search the sorted suffix for the required complement.

timeComplexity.explanation: There can be one binary search for each index.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only loop indexes and search bounds are stored.

solutions.title: Two pointers from both ends
solutions.strategy: Move the left pointer right when the sum is too small and the right pointer left when the sum is too large.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each pointer moves inward at most n times total.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only two pointer indexes are stored.
